reviews.name: Sofia Calderon
reviews.text: This was my first-ever group trip and my first SYB adventure, and now I’m hooked. I signed up for Ireland mainly for the hiking, but ended up loving everything we did, from workouts with epic views to moments I’ll never forget. The small group size was perfect, it meant I got to actually know and connect with everyone. I also planned this trip because it fell on my birthday, and honestly, celebrating with a bunch of “strangers” (who quickly became friends) was the best decision I’ve ever made. Dan, Bradford, and Matas went above and beyond the entire time. Already counting down to my next SYB trip!

reviews.name: Lorena Morfín
reviews.text:
I just came back from an unforgettable trip to Ireland with Surf Yoga Beer, and it was even better than I imagined.

The experience was perfectly curated from start to finish. The leaders are incredible, fun, inspiring, and masters at creating deep group connection from day one. You instantly feel part of something special.

Every activity was amazing: from stunning hikes to energizing yoga and bootcamp sessions. Everything is taken care of for you, so all you have to do is show up and enjoy the ride.

Fair warning: you might need a vacation after your vacation because it’s full of adventure, movement, and unforgettable moments. But it’s all SO worth it. The memories, the laughs, the new friends, the joy... I’d do it all over again in a heartbeat.

If you're thinking about it, GO. You won’t regret it.

reviews.name: Katherine Moncrief (Kat)
reviews.text:
I just wrapped the SYB Ireland '25 trip, and it was everything I could've hoped for (and more) as a solo, social traveller. Our week moving across the country was a great balance of challenging physical activity, breathtaking sightseeing, authentic local immersion, and deep human connection. It was an adventure that I never could've designed for myself, and I'm so grateful to SYB for magic magic feel totally accessible.

I'd leave the review with a good ol' SYB "Don't think, just do!" and tell you to book right now if you're even thinking about it. But, if you're like me and you crave details, here's a bit more to tip you over the edge!

The Workouts: We did varied and challenging forms of exercise, which felt natural to our setting (Ireland = hiking, surfing, outdoor yoga, beach running) and were designed to push us out of our comfort zones. But we had the support of our team every time, which made everything -- even, in my case, hiking your first mountain -- possible. SYB is designed to let you focus on people, places, and pushing yourself, and not...

The Logistics: Book the trip, book your flights, and SYB takes care of the rest. It's really that easy! Our SYB leaders guided us through a thoughtful, packed schedule, and had arranged nice local hotels, an incredible bus driver, and quality food along the way. We really got  to "clock out" of planning for ourselves and "clock in" to that magic planned for us. Speaking of which...

The Plans: Ireland was the perfect balance of tourist -- the Guinness Factory, Temple Bar, the Cliffs of Moher -- and off the beaten path -- hiking Carrauntoohil, surfing Lahinch beach, head-banging in a Killarney pub to Zombie, yoga in an abandoned monastery. We checked the typical boxes, so it felt like we really "did" Ireland, but focused on immersing in both the nature and the culture of the place. And all of this was thanks to...

The Leaders: Ireland was run by a group of clear-eyed, full-hearted, creative leaders. Bradford and Dan were just extraordinary. At any given time they were coaches, teachers, cheerleaders, guides, party starters, and sometimes therapists -- you name it, they did it. We also had an incredible photographer in Matas, who allowed us to be off our phones and in every moment. If you see any of these guys running an SYB, book it! They will do a great job with you and...

The People: Trips like SYB are self-selecting for people who travel the same way: fun, flexible, social, and with a bit of spice. No surprise, then, that the squad on this Ireland trip was "the craic"! I feel like I quickly made real, lasting friendships from all over, made possible only by SYB. That's not just the icing on the cake, it is the cake.

So, I'll summarize the review the same way I started it: If you're considering an SYB trip, don't think and just do! Friends, magic, and adventure await!

reviews.name: Joshua Kline
reviews.text: Great travel company. Just got back from Ireland, lead by Bradford and Dan, plus photographer Matas. All did a great job to make it great for everyone. You'll do amazing things and connect with amazing people.

reviews.name: Peter Zhang
reviews.text:
Surf Yoga Beer changed the game for me. I came for the adventure and the fun, and wow, it delivered. But I left with something so much more: real friendships, deep connection, and a sense of community I didn’t know I needed.

Bradford is the spiritual soul of the trip. His energy is magnetic, and he sets a tone that invites everyone to show up as their best, boldest selves. Whether it was summiting a mountain, dancing till 2am, or finding stillness in a yoga practice inside a 700-year-old abbey, the group brought a contagious energy and a willingness to dive in physically, socially, and spiritually.

There’s something powerful about being surrounded by people who push themselves and lift each other up at the same time. I would never have discovered the places we explored, from yoga in historic ruins to the best races in Galway, without SYB. The trip felt both wildly spontaneous and beautifully curated.

More than anything, this experience reminded me of what Aristotle called friendships of virtue: bonds built not on convenience or entertainment, but on shared values, mutual growth, and showing up for each other. That’s what SYB gave me.

This isn’t just a trip. It’s a community, and I’m so glad I found it.

reviews.name: Kelly Holton
reviews.text: If you’re contemplating a trip with SYB then I have three words for you. JUST DO IT! I know meeting a group of strangers to travel is a bit scary and intimidating but I promise it will be an amazing experience! I just returned home from SYB Ireland and can’t wait to book my next trip with this group! My group leaders were kind, supportive and always kept me smiling. Strangers on day 1 will become friends by day 2. I miss my SYB Ireland group already. All in all, 10/10, highly recommend!

reviews.name: Laura Finkelstein
reviews.text: SYB Ireland was my first group tour experience. Though I wasn’t quite sure what to expect, it blew anything I thought it would be like out of the water. I chose Ireland purely for the city, the hikes, and beautiful landscapes (which were all A+), but the SYB experience took it to the next level. Our tour leaders Bradford and Dan were so organized, our driver Nick got us where we needed to go safely and on time, and our photographer Matas made sure to capture all the group smiles, giggles, and wonders. Not to mention how 13 strangers instantly came together to become close friends. The trip had one-of-kind experiences, from the most amazing hike, to yoga in a 600+ year old Abbey, and a beach workout with a sunset straight out of a coloring book. These activities would be 5 stars alone, but because of SYB, I would rate this trip 10 stars if I could. Can’t wait for the next one.

reviews.name: Lisette B
reviews.text: Having been on at least one trip a year over the past 5 years, I cannot be more grateful for SYB and to be part of the SYB family. Not only have I been to places I would have never been myself such as deserted islands in the Philippines or the mountains of Ireland, the sense of adventure and friendship on those trips unmatched! A week with SYB feels like a month on any other holiday, because they make sure you’ll be doing all the things. I made lifelong friends and every trip is more special than the last. Doing things out of your comfort zone is great for lifelong bonding with your new friends and feeling on top of the world after every trip. A special shoutout to all the leaders who bring all the energy to make sure you have the trip of lifetime. DON’T THINK JUST DO and book that trip!!!!
